children: Oil prices edge lower in early Asian trade. "The Trump administration continues to talk up its efforts to support oil flows, with Energy Secretary Chris Wright saying they had recovered to about 80% of their pre-conflict levels," ANZ Research analysts say in a report. However, "efforts to support the fuel market are likely to fall short," the analysts say, pointing to "rising supply risks in the Middle East." Iran has been providing Yemen's Houthi militia with intelligence and targeting assistance for attacks on Saudi Arabia, the WSJ reported. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 0.3% lower at $103.32 a barrel, while front-month Brent crude oil futures are down 0.2% at $109.36 a barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
